source.text: וְאֵ֤לֶּה הָיוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י דָויִ֔דאֲשֶׁ֥ר נֽוֹלַד־ל֖וֹ בְּחֶבְר֑וֹן הַבְּכ֣וֹר׀אַמְנֹ֗ן לַאֲחִינֹ֨עַם֙ הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֔ית שֵׁנִי֙ דָּנִיֵּ֔אל לַאֲבִיגַ֖יִל הַֽכַּרְמְלִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: And these were [the] sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelite; second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelite;

en.L: And these were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn [was] Amnon, by Ahinoam the Jezreelite; [the] second, Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelite;
en.B: The sons born to David in Hebron were these: the firstborn, Amnon, whose mother was Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second, Daniel, whose mother was Abigail of Carmel;
en.R: These were the sons born to David while he was in Hebron. The oldest was Amnon, and his mother was Ahinoam from the town of Jezreel. The second son was Daniel, and his mother was Abigail from Carmel.

es.L: Y estos fueron los hijos de David que le nacieron en Hebrón: el primogénito [fue] Amnón, de Ahinoam la jezreelita; [el] segundo, Daniel, de Abigail la carmelita;
es.B: Los hijos que le nacieron a David en Hebrón fueron estos: el primogénito, Amnón, cuya madre era Ahinoam de Jezreel; el segundo, Daniel, cuya madre era Abigail de Carmel;
es.R: Estos fueron los hijos que le nacieron a David mientras estaba en Hebrón. El mayor fue Amnón, y su madre era Ahinoam, del pueblo de Jezreel. El segundo hijo fue Daniel, y su madre era Abigail, de Carmel.

fr.L: Et voici les fils de David qui lui naquirent à Hébron : le premier-né, Amnon, d’Ahinoam la Jizreélite ; le deuxième, Daniel, d’Abigaïl la Carmélite ;
fr.B: Voici les fils qui naquirent à David à Hébron : le premier-né, Amnon, dont la mère était Ahinoam de Jizreël ; le deuxième, Daniel, dont la mère était Abigaïl de Carmel ;
fr.R: Voici les fils qui sont nés à David pendant qu’il était à Hébron. L’aîné était Amnon, et sa mère était Ahinoam, de la ville de Jizreël. Le deuxième fils était Daniel, et sa mère était Abigaïl, de Carmel.

sw.L: Na hawa walikuwa wana wa Daudi waliozaliwa kwake huko Hebroni: mzaliwa wa kwanza [alikuwa] Amnoni, kwa Ahinoamu Myezreeli; wa pili, Danieli, kwa Abigaili Mkarmeli;
sw.B: Wana waliozaliwa kwa Daudi huko Hebroni ni hawa: mzaliwa wa kwanza, Amnoni, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Ahinoamu wa Yezreeli; wa pili, Danieli, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Abigaili wa Karmeli;
sw.R: Hawa ndio wana waliozaliwa kwa Daudi alipokuwa Hebroni. Wa kwanza alikuwa Amnoni, na mama yake alikuwa Ahinoamu wa mji wa Yezreeli. Mwana wa pili alikuwa Danieli, na mama yake alikuwa Abigaili wa Karmeli.

vi.L: Và đây là các con trai của Đa-vít đã sinh cho ông tại Hếp-rôn: con trưởng nam [là] Am-nôn, do A-hi-nô-am người Gít-rê-ên; con thứ hai, Đa-ni-ên, do A-bi-ga-in người Cạt-mên;
vi.B: Đây là các con trai sinh cho Đa-vít tại Hếp-rôn: con trưởng nam là Am-nôn, mẹ là A-hi-nô-am người Gít-rê-ên; con thứ hai là Đa-ni-ên, mẹ là A-bi-ga-in người Cạt-mên;
vi.R: Đây là các con trai sinh ra cho Đa-vít khi ông còn ở Hếp-rôn. Con trai lớn nhất là Am-nôn, mẹ là A-hi-nô-am, quê ở thị trấn Gít-rê-ên. Con trai thứ hai là Đa-ni-ên, mẹ là A-bi-ga-in, quê ở Cạt-mên.

ko.L: 그리고 헤브론에서 다윗에게 태어난 다윗의 아들들은 이러하다. 맏아들은 이스르엘 여자 아히노암에게서 [난] 암논이고, 둘째는 갈멜 여자 아비가일에게서 [난] 다니엘이고,
ko.B: 헤브론에서 다윗에게 태어난 아들들은 이러하다. 맏아들은 암논인데 그의 어머니는 이스르엘 출신 아히노암이었고, 둘째는 다니엘인데 그의 어머니는 갈멜 출신 아비가일이었고,
ko.R: 다윗이 헤브론에 있을 때 태어난 아들들은 이러하다. 맏아들은 암논이었고, 그의 어머니는 이스르엘 마을에서 온 아히노암이었다. 둘째 아들은 다니엘이었고, 그의 어머니는 갈멜에서 온 아비가일이었다.

decisions.choice: the same list as 2 Samuel 3:2-5
decisions.reason: Verses 1-4 repeat the list of David's sons born at Hebron from 2 Samuel 3:2-5, with small differences noted verse by verse. Here Abigail is called "the Carmelite" where Samuel calls her "the wife of Nabal the Carmelite" (2 Samuel 3:3).

decisions.choice: Daniel: the son called Chileab in 2 Samuel 3:3
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 3:3 names Abigail's son Chileab; this list names him Daniel. He may have had two names. Nothing more is told of him.

decisions.choice: of Jezreel, of Carmel: towns in the hill country of Judah
decisions.reason: Both women came from towns in Judah near each other (Joshua 15:55-56), not from the northern Jezreel or Mount Carmel by the sea. David married them while he was on the run from Saul (1 Samuel 25:42-43).

decisions.choice: whose mother was (Balanced); his mother was (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "by Ahinoam". As in 2 Samuel 3:2, Balanced and Readable say plainly that she was the boy's mother, and the list keeps the same wording for each son.

decisions.choice: "cuya madre era" (B); "y su madre era" (R)
decisions.reason: Verses 1-4 repeat 2 Samuel 3:2-5, and Spanish reuses the Samuel wording: Balanced and Readable say plainly that each woman was the boy's mother, as there.

decisions.choice: the wording of the French 2 Samuel 3:2-5 at each level ("dont la mère était", "et sa mère était")
decisions.reason: Verses 1-4 repeat 2 Samuel 3:2-5 with the same Hebrew for most words, so each level reuses that passage's French and changes only what the Hebrew changes (Daniel for Kiléab, no mention of Nabal).

decisions.choice: kwa Ahinoamu (L); ambaye mama yake alikuwa (B); na mama yake alikuwa (R)
decisions.reason: The list of David's sons reuses the Swahili wording of 2 Samuel 3:2-5 at each level, changing only what the Hebrew changes here (Danieli for Kileabu, Abigaili without Nabal).

decisions.choice: wording of the Vietnamese 2 Samuel 3:2-5: "do X [sinh ra]" (L); "mẹ là X" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Verses 1-4 repeat 2 Samuel 3:2-5, so each level keeps the Samuel wording and changes only what the Hebrew of Chronicles changes (Daniel for Chileab, "the Carmelite" for "the wife of Nabal the Carmelite").

decisions.choice: the wording of the Korean 2 Samuel 3:2-5
decisions.reason: The list repeats 2 Samuel 3:2-5, so each level keeps that passage's Korean ("...에게서 [난]" at Literal, "그의 어머니는 ...이었다" at Balanced and Readable), changing only what the Hebrew changes (Daniel for Chileab, no mention of Nabal).

source.text: הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ לְאַבְשָׁל֣וֹם בֶּֽן־מַעֲכָ֔ה בַּת־תַּלְמַ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ גְּשׁ֑וּר הָרְבִיעִ֖י אֲדֹנִיָּ֥ה בֶן־חַגִּֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: the third, of Absalom son of Maacah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth Adonijah son of Haggith;

en.L: the third [was] Absalom son of Maacah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah son of Haggith;
en.B: the third was Absalom, whose mother was Maacah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth was Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith;
en.R: The third son was Absalom, and his mother was Maacah. She was the daughter of Talmai, the king of Geshur. The fourth son was Adonijah, and his mother was Haggith.

es.L: el tercero [fue] Absalón hijo de Maaca, hija de Talmai rey de Gesur; el cuarto, Adonías hijo de Haguit;
es.B: el tercero fue Absalón, cuya madre era Maaca, hija de Talmai, rey de Gesur; el cuarto fue Adonías, cuya madre era Haguit;
es.R: El tercer hijo fue Absalón, y su madre era Maaca. Ella era hija de Talmai, el rey de Gesur. El cuarto hijo fue Adonías, y su madre era Haguit.

fr.L: le troisième, Absalom, fils de Maaka, fille de Talmaï, roi de Gueshour ; le quatrième, Adonias, fils de Haggith ;
fr.B: le troisième fut Absalom, dont la mère était Maaka, fille de Talmaï, roi de Gueshour ; le quatrième fut Adonias, dont la mère était Haggith ;
fr.R: Le troisième fils était Absalom, et sa mère était Maaka. Elle était la fille de Talmaï, le roi de Gueshour. Le quatrième fils était Adonias, et sa mère était Haggith.

sw.L: wa tatu [alikuwa] Absalomu mwana wa Maaka binti Talmai mfalme wa Geshuri; wa nne, Adoniya mwana wa Hagithi;
sw.B: wa tatu alikuwa Absalomu, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Maaka binti Talmai mfalme wa Geshuri; wa nne alikuwa Adoniya, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Hagithi;
sw.R: Mwana wa tatu alikuwa Absalomu, na mama yake alikuwa Maaka. Yeye alikuwa binti wa Talmai, mfalme wa Geshuri. Mwana wa nne alikuwa Adoniya, na mama yake alikuwa Hagithi.

vi.L: con thứ ba [là] Áp-sa-lôm con trai của Ma-a-ca con gái Thanh-mai vua Ghê-su-rơ; con thứ tư, A-đô-ni-gia con trai của Ha-ghít;
vi.B: con thứ ba là Áp-sa-lôm, mẹ là Ma-a-ca, con gái Thanh-mai vua Ghê-su-rơ; con thứ tư là A-đô-ni-gia, mẹ là Ha-ghít;
vi.R: Con trai thứ ba là Áp-sa-lôm, mẹ là Ma-a-ca. Bà là con gái của Thanh-mai, vua xứ Ghê-su-rơ. Con trai thứ tư là A-đô-ni-gia, mẹ là Ha-ghít.

ko.L: 셋째는 그술 왕 달매의 딸 마아가의 아들 압살롬이고, 넷째는 학깃의 아들 아도니야이고,
ko.B: 셋째는 압살롬인데 그의 어머니는 그술 왕 달매의 딸 마아가였고, 넷째는 아도니야인데 그의 어머니는 학깃이었고,
ko.R: 셋째 아들은 압살롬이었고, 그의 어머니는 마아가였다. 마아가는 그술 왕 달매의 딸이었다. 넷째 아들은 아도니야였고, 그의 어머니는 학깃이었다.

decisions.choice: the third was Absalom
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has a small word meaning "to" or "of" before Absalom's name that does not fit the pattern of the list. It may be a slip in copying, and 2 Samuel 3:3 does not have it. The meaning is the same either way: Absalom was the third son.

decisions.choice: Maacah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 3:3: Geshur was a small Aramean kingdom east of the Sea of Galilee, and the marriage sealed an alliance with its king.

decisions.choice: whose mother was (Balanced); his mother was (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "son of Maacah", "son of Haggith". As in verse 1, Balanced and Readable say that she was his mother.

source.text: הַחֲמִישִׁ֥י שְׁפַטְיָ֖ה לַאֲבִיטָ֑ל הַשִּׁשִּׁ֥י יִתְרְעָ֖ם לְעֶגְלָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: the fifth Shephatiah, of Abital; the sixth Ithream, of Eglah his wife.

en.L: the fifth [was] Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah his wife.
en.B: the fifth was Shephatiah, whose mother was Abital; the sixth was Ithream, whose mother was Eglah his wife.
en.R: The fifth son was Shephatiah, and his mother was Abital. The sixth son was Ithream, and his mother was Eglah, another of David's wives.

es.L: el quinto [fue] Sefatías, de Abital; el sexto, Itream, de Egla su mujer.
es.B: el quinto fue Sefatías, cuya madre era Abital; el sexto fue Itream, cuya madre era Egla, su esposa.
es.R: El quinto hijo fue Sefatías, y su madre era Abital. El sexto hijo fue Itream, y su madre era Egla, otra de las esposas de David.

fr.L: le cinquième, Shephatia, d’Abital ; le sixième, Ithream, d’Égla sa femme.
fr.B: le cinquième fut Shephatia, dont la mère était Abital ; le sixième fut Ithream, dont la mère était Égla, femme de David.
fr.R: Le cinquième fils était Shephatia, et sa mère était Abital. Le sixième fils était Ithream, et sa mère était Égla, une autre des femmes de David.

sw.L: wa tano [alikuwa] Shefatia, kwa Abitali; wa sita, Ithreamu, kwa Egla mke wake.
sw.B: wa tano alikuwa Shefatia, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Abitali; wa sita alikuwa Ithreamu, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Egla mke wake.
sw.R: Mwana wa tano alikuwa Shefatia, na mama yake alikuwa Abitali. Mwana wa sita alikuwa Ithreamu, na mama yake alikuwa Egla, mke mwingine wa Daudi.

vi.L: con thứ năm [là] Sê-pha-tia, do A-bi-tanh; con thứ sáu, Dít-rê-am, do Éc-la vợ ông.
vi.B: con thứ năm là Sê-pha-tia, mẹ là A-bi-tanh; con thứ sáu là Dít-rê-am, mẹ là Éc-la, vợ ông.
vi.R: Con trai thứ năm là Sê-pha-tia, mẹ là A-bi-tanh. Con trai thứ sáu là Dít-rê-am, mẹ là Éc-la, một người vợ khác của Đa-vít.

ko.L: 다섯째는 아비달에게서 [난] 스바댜이고, 여섯째는 그의 아내 에글라에게서 [난] 이드르암이다.
ko.B: 다섯째는 스바댜인데 그의 어머니는 아비달이었고, 여섯째는 이드르암인데 그의 어머니는 다윗의 아내 에글라였다.
ko.R: 다섯째 아들은 스바댜였고, 그의 어머니는 아비달이었다. 여섯째 아들은 이드르암이었고, 그의 어머니는 다윗의 또 다른 아내 에글라였다.

decisions.choice: Eglah his wife
decisions.reason: All six mothers were David's wives, but only Eglah is called "his wife", as 2 Samuel 3:5 calls her "David's wife". The words probably round off the list.

decisions.choice: another of David's wives
decisions.reason: Readable adds "another of" so that Eglah is not taken to be David's only wife, as in 2 Samuel 3:5.

source.text: שִׁשָּׁה֙ נֽוֹלַד־ל֣וֹ בְחֶבְר֔וֹן וַיִּ֨מְלָךְ־שָׁ֔ם שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Six were born to him in Hebron, and he reigned there seven years and six months; and thirty and three years he reigned in Jerusalem.

en.L: Six were born to him in Hebron, and he reigned there seven years and six months; and thirty-three years he reigned in Jerusalem.
en.B: Six sons were born to him in Hebron, where he reigned for seven years and six months. In Jerusalem he reigned for thirty-three years.
en.R: Six sons were born to David in Hebron. He ruled there for seven and a half years, and then he ruled from Jerusalem for thirty-three years.

es.L: Seis le nacieron en Hebrón, y reinó allí siete años y seis meses; y treinta y tres años reinó en Jerusalén.
es.B: Seis hijos le nacieron en Hebrón, donde reinó durante siete años y seis meses. En Jerusalén reinó durante treinta y tres años.
es.R: Seis hijos le nacieron a David en Hebrón. Gobernó allí durante siete años y medio, y después gobernó desde Jerusalén durante treinta y tres años.

fr.L: Six lui naquirent à Hébron, et il régna là sept ans et six mois ; et trente-trois ans il régna à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Six fils lui naquirent à Hébron, où il régna sept ans et six mois. À Jérusalem, il régna trente-trois ans.
fr.R: Six fils sont nés à David à Hébron. Il a régné là-bas sept ans et demi, puis il a régné à Jérusalem pendant trente-trois ans.

sw.L: Sita walizaliwa kwake huko Hebroni, naye alitawala huko miaka saba na miezi sita; na miaka thelathini na mitatu alitawala huko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Wana sita walizaliwa kwake huko Hebroni, alikotawala kwa miaka saba na miezi sita. Huko Yerusalemu alitawala kwa miaka thelathini na mitatu.
sw.R: Wana sita walizaliwa kwa Daudi huko Hebroni. Alitawala huko kwa miaka saba na nusu, kisha akatawala akiwa Yerusalemu kwa miaka thelathini na mitatu.

vi.L: Sáu [người] đã sinh cho ông tại Hếp-rôn, và ông trị vì tại đó bảy năm sáu tháng; và ba mươi ba năm ông trị vì tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Sáu con trai ấy sinh cho ông tại Hếp-rôn, nơi ông trị vì bảy năm sáu tháng. Tại Giê-ru-sa-lem ông trị vì ba mươi ba năm.
vi.R: Sáu con trai ấy sinh ra cho Đa-vít tại Hếp-rôn. Ông cai trị tại đó bảy năm rưỡi, rồi cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem ba mươi ba năm.

ko.L: 여섯이 헤브론에서 그에게 태어났다. 그리고 그는 거기에서 7년 6개월을 다스렸고, 33년을 예루살렘에서 다스렸다.
ko.B: 헤브론에서 그에게 여섯 아들이 태어났다. 그는 그곳에서 7년 6개월 동안 다스렸고, 예루살렘에서는 33년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.R: 헤브론에서 다윗에게 여섯 아들이 태어났다. 다윗은 그곳에서 7년 반 동안 다스렸고, 그 뒤에 예루살렘에서 33년 동안 다스렸다.

decisions.choice: the length of David's reign, as in 2 Samuel 5:5
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 5:5 gives the same figures: seven years and six months over Judah at Hebron, then thirty-three years in Jerusalem. Here they are joined to the list of sons, which is divided between the sons born in Hebron and those born in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: six: the six sons named in verses 1-3
decisions.reason: The count matches the names listed.

decisions.choice: six sons; David (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "six were born to him". Balanced and Readable add "sons", and Readable names David, since a new sentence begins.

decisions.choice: the years in figures ("7년 6개월", "33년")
alternatives: 일곱 해 여섯 달; 서른세 해
decisions.reason: The Korean 2 Samuel 5:5 writes these numbers in words; Chronicles writes years and ages in figures, as the Korean 1 and 2 Kings do.

source.text: וְאֵ֥לֶּה נוּלְּדוּ־ל֖וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑יִם שִׁ֠מְעָא וְשׁוֹבָ֞ב וְנָתָ֤ן וּשְׁלֹמֹה֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לְבַת־שׁ֖וּעַ בַּת־עַמִּיאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea and Shobab and Nathan and Solomon, four, of Bathshua daughter of Ammiel;

en.L: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea and Shobab and Nathan and Solomon, four, by Bathshua daughter of Ammiel;
en.B: These were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan and Solomon, the four sons whose mother was Bathshua daughter of Ammiel;
en.R: These sons were born to David in Jerusalem. Shimea, Shobab, Nathan and Solomon were the four sons of Bathshua, the daughter of Ammiel.

es.L: Y estos le nacieron en Jerusalén: Simea y Sobab y Natán y Salomón, cuatro, de Betsúa hija de Amiel;
es.B: Estos le nacieron en Jerusalén: Simea, Sobab, Natán y Salomón, los cuatro hijos cuya madre era Betsúa hija de Amiel;
es.R: Estos hijos le nacieron a David en Jerusalén. Simea, Sobab, Natán y Salomón fueron los cuatro hijos de Betsúa, la hija de Amiel.

fr.L: Et ceux-ci lui naquirent à Jérusalem : Shiméa et Shobab et Nathan et Salomon, quatre, de Bathshoua, fille d’Ammiel ;
fr.B: Ceux-ci lui naquirent à Jérusalem : Shiméa, Shobab, Nathan et Salomon, les quatre fils dont la mère était Bathshoua, fille d’Ammiel ;

decisions.choice: Bathshua daughter of Ammiel: Bathsheba daughter of Eliam

decisions.choice: the same list as 2 Samuel 5:14-16
decisions.reason: Verses 5-8 repeat the list of sons born in Jerusalem from 2 Samuel 5:14-16, which 1 Chronicles 14:4-7 gives again. Here Shammua is spelled Shimea, and the list adds that the first four were Bathsheba's sons.

decisions.choice: Solomon named last of the four
decisions.reason: Solomon was born after the death of David and Bathsheba's first child (2 Samuel 12:24), yet he is named last. The list may not be in order of birth; nothing else is told of the other three except Nathan.

decisions.choice: the four sons

decisions.choice: "Betsúa"

decisions.choice: Bathshoua, as the Hebrew spells her name here

decisions.choice: "Bát-sua", the form Chronicles uses for Bathsheba
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here reads Bathshua; the Vietnamese follows it, as the English does, and the meaning decision says she is Bathsheba ("Bát-sê-ba" in Samuel).

decisions.choice: "시므아" and "밧수아" as Chronicles spells them

decisions.choice: the order of the four sons
decisions.reason: 2 Kings gives the ages of three of these sons when they became king (23:31, 36; 24:18). By those ages Jehoiakim was the oldest of the three, then Shallum, then Zedekiah, so Shallum, here fourth, was older than Zedekiah. The list may be ordered by something other than birth, such as the order of their reigns or their importance. Johanan is not mentioned anywhere else; he may have died young.

decisions.choice: Jehoiakim and Zedekiah: kings with names given by foreign rulers

decisions.choice: Zerubbabel son of Pedaiah, not son of Shealtiel
decisions.reason: Ezra 3:2, Nehemiah 12:1 and Haggai 1:1 call Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel; here his father is Pedaiah, Shealtiel's brother. Shealtiel may have died without children, and Pedaiah may have fathered a son in his brother's name (Deuteronomy 25:5-6); or "son of Shealtiel" may mean grandson or heir. Some manuscripts of the ancient Greek translation read "Shealtiel" here.

decisions.choice: son of Zerubbabel: a singular word before a list
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "son of Zerubbabel" and then names several children. Lists in Chronicles sometimes use the singular this way (also verses 21 and 23); it means "sons".

decisions.choice: Shelomith their sister
decisions.reason: A daughter is seldom named in these lists; Shelomith must have been known in her own day. Nothing more is told of her.

alternatives: Rephaiah his son, Arnan his son, Obadiah his son, Shecaniah his son
